answer: Gate rewards on a counterparty-diversity threshold: an identity earns only after 20 distinct counterparties in an epoch, its history anchored on-chain. A farmer's 1,000 fakes trade with each other, so their set narrows to one canyon, not a broad market, and the threshold blocks them. Faking diversity costs 30 units per outside trade, so 1,000 fakes need 600,000 units; an honest agent climbs the knoll once, pays 600, and keeps undiluted rewards.
